Paper Name: Hybrid off‑grid energy systems optimal sizing with integrated hydrogen storage based on deterministic balance approach
NOTES: Two case studies presented: Case 1 (solar PV/hydrogen) used as primary. Case 2 (solar PV/wind/hydrogen) has LCOE = 0.2116 $/kWh and includes wind turbine (250 kW WTG as base unit). Cap_FC stated as 300 kW in text but FC nominal power per Table 5 is 250 kW — text value used. Cap_EL stated as '800 kW and 1000 kW, respectively' (ambiguous); 800 kW matches ELZ capital cost ($960,000 ÷ $1,200/kW = 800 kW) so 800 kW used. H2 tank efficiency 98% stated in Table 5 but not a standard extraction column. eta_INVT not reported; AC losses assumed ~7% in text but this is wiring losses. N_H2: 'ten compressors paired with ten hydrogen tanks, plus an additional tank' = 11 tanks implied but exact number unclear. Temperature coefficient (α) = -0.331%/°C reported in nomenclature. ESP = 0.0788 USD/kWh used as p_grid (electricity selling price). No diesel generator used — all Cap_DG, f_0, f_1, c_DG_cap, c_DG, c_DG_FUEL, om_DG, rc_DG, e_DG, P_DG_min, life_DG, N_DG are null. Rated power of PV module (0.335 kW) reported instead of wind turbine rated power since no wind turbine in primary case. System modeled for Cairo International Airport, Egypt. Peak load = 250 kW. Simulation tool: DBM, validated with HOMER Pro. AC primary load = 1,582,615 kWh/year reported from HOMER simulation (explicitly stated). Operating costs (c_FC, c_EL) not separately reported from O&M costs.
